blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is heading ka number “7.1.2.3” chhapa hai. Yeh 7.3.2 (Impacts of the Digital Divide) ka teesra hissa hai, is liye sahi number 7.3.2.3 hai.

Digital divide social aur civic participation (muashre ke kaamon aur hukumati kaamon mein hissa lena) par bhi asar dalta hai. Social media, online news aur digital government services ki madad se log informed (har baat se khabardar) rehte hain aur civic activities (shehri kaamon) mein hissa lete hain. Lekin jin ke paas in cheezon ka access (pohanch) nahi, woh aksar in mauqon se bahar reh jate hain, aur democratic processes (jamhooriyat ke kaam, jaise hukumat ke faislon mein raaye dena) mein un ki representation (un ki awaz shamil hona) aur participation (hissa lena) kam ho jati hai.

Misal: Pakistan mein e-government services (online sarkari services) shehron mein zyada aasani se milti hain, is liye rural (dehaati, gaon ke) logon ke paas hukumati kaamon mein hissa lene ya social services (logon ki madad wali sarkari services) tak pohanchne ke kam tareeqe hain.

blocks.prompt: Social aur civic participation par digital divide ke do asar bataiye. (Short question 4)
blocks.explanation: 1) Jin ke paas access nahi woh social media aur online news se kam informed rehte hain, is liye democratic processes mein un ki representation aur participation kam hoti hai. 2) E-government services zyada tar shehron mein aasani se milti hain, is liye dehaati log hukumati kaamon mein hissa lene aur social services tak pohanchne mein peeche reh jate hain.

items: Civic asar: kam maloomat, kam representation, dehaati ilaqon mein e-government services tak kam access.
